note: Names the adapter may pin to an exact IPA pronunciation. Entries marked unconfirmed are best estimates; set status to confirmed only after the person who owns the name, or a verified recording of them, settles it. The checker (check_name_pronunciation.py) reports CONFIRMED only for confirmed entries. finalPhone is the sound that most often goes wrong and is checked on its own.

Sarosh.note: Owner's given name. The risk is an ending like j or ge, which speech-to-text has produced (heard as saroj).

plainNote: Terms the term gate (check_script_terms.py) accepts without a pinned pronunciation: ordinary words and common first names a standard voice reads correctly by default. Adding a term here is a decision, not a verification; check_name_pronunciation.py is the verifier.
